fieldPlaceholders.Alle in deze uitvoering verwerkte bundle: All bundles processed in this run are rolled back. The whole run fails.
fieldPlaceholders.Alle tot nu toe verwerkte bundles worden: All bundles processed so far are marked successful. The failing bundle and everything after it is skipped.

Dear {kandidaat.voornaam},

Thank you for your application. Unfortunately … ({afwijsreden}).

Kind regards,
{recruiter.naam}
fieldPlaceholders.De fout wordt genegeerd en de uitvoering: The error is ignored and the run continues with the next bundle.
fieldPlaceholders.Er is een nieuwe match aangemaakt: A new match has been created.
fieldPlaceholders.Plak hier dienst-IDs, één per regel of k:
Paste shift IDs here, one per line or comma-separated:
12345
12346
12347
fieldPlaceholders.Waarde die de foutieve output vervangt: Value that replaces the failing output
fieldPlaceholders.bijv {{klant_id}} — leeg laten voor één: e.g. {{klant_id}}. Leave empty for one big group
fieldPlaceholders.leeg = mobiel van de kandidaat · eigen 0: empty = candidate's mobile · your own number = test mode
fieldPlaceholders.{{1output}} of leeg laten voor volledige: {{1.output}} or leave empty for the full output

fieldHints.Array stuurt elk item apart door naar de: Array sends each item to the next module separately (like an Iterator).
fieldHints.De module waarvan de items worden sameng: The module whose items are merged. Usually the Iterator right before this module.
fieldHints.De uitvoering gaat door alsof de module: The run continues as if the module had returned this value.
fieldHints.Eerst proefdraaien — rapporteert wat er: Dry-run first. Reports what WOULD change without writing anything.
fieldHints.Elke regel of komma-gescheiden waarde wo: Each line or comma-separated value is treated as a separate shift ID.
fieldHints.Hoe vaak de volgende modules worden uitg: How many times the following modules run.
fieldHints.Kies of maak de inbound webhook die deze: Choose or create the inbound webhook that starts this workflow.
fieldHints.Met hoeveel de teller per herhaling opho: How much the counter increments per repeat.
fieldHints.Plak hier een JSON array of object De vo: Paste a JSON array or object here. The next module receives it as input.
fieldHints.Selecteer een specifiek element uit de H: Select a specific element from the HTML.
fieldHints.Startwaarde van de teller ({{i}}) bij de: Start value of the counter ({{i}}) on the first repeat.
fieldHints.Velden die per item worden verzameld in: Fields collected per item into the output array.
fieldHints.Vereist dat \"onvolledige uitvoeringen o: Requires "store incomplete runs" to be enabled in the workflow settings.
fieldHints.Welk veld uit de vorige module bevat de: Which field from the previous module holds the array to iterate over.
fieldHints.Welk veld wordt gebruikt als identifier: Which field is used as the identifier in the next module.
fieldHints.Sla kandidaten over die al coördinaten h: Skip candidates that already have coordinates. Recommended for bulk.
fieldHints.Leeg = alle statussen (blacklist is alti: Empty = all statuses (blacklist is always excluded).
fieldHints.Bijv alleen uitzendkrachten of ZZP'ers L: E.g. only temp workers or freelancers. Empty = all contract forms.
fieldHints.Alleen relevant wanneer de gekoppelde en: Only relevant when the linked entity is a customer.
fieldHints.Sla records over die al een koppeling me: Skip records that already have a link with this system. Recommended for bulk.
fieldHints.Leeg = geen contactfilter (alle kandidat: Empty = no contact filter (all candidates are included).
fieldHints.{{kandidaatid}} = draait per kandidaat u: {{kandidaat.id}} = runs per candidate from the previous step (bulk; empty works too). For a single candidate: {{trigger.candidate_id}} (drill-down button or address change).
fieldHints.Ondersteunt {maand} voor de huidige maan: Supports {maand} for the current month name.
fieldHints.De tenant-instelling webhook_endpoint_<s: The tenant setting webhook_endpoint_<slug> determines the URL.
fieldHints.Tekst die op de kandidaat en in de audit: Text that is stamped on the candidate and in the audit trail.
fieldHints.De workflow die als kind wordt gestart (: The workflow started as a child (async, via the queue). Self-calls and cycles are refused; maximum 5 levels deep.
fieldHints.Eerst proefdraaien rapporteert WIE er aa: Dry-run first: reports WHO would be created (incl. payload), writes nothing. Turn off explicitly to really create in Shiftmanager.
fieldHints.De voorwaarden volgen altijd de matchcri: The conditions always follow the vacancy's own match criteria: to change them, change the match criteria or the weighting templates. This step only picks the set.
fieldHints.Datum en tijd (bv 10-08-2026 1400) of ee: Date and time (e.g. 10-08-2026 14:00) or a variable.
fieldHints.Idempotentie dezelfde template gaat binn: Idempotency: the same template is not sent to the same candidate again within this window (0 = always send).
fieldHints.Optioneel Bijv whatsapp_consent verstuur: Optional. E.g. whatsapp_consent: send ONLY when this field is present and true on the candidate row (missing field = no send).
fieldHints.Optioneel Bijv whatsapp_consent sla deze: Optional. E.g. whatsapp_consent: skip this e-mail when the candidate has that field set to true (prevents a double send alongside a WhatsApp step).
fieldHints.Optioneel Zet een rolnaam (bv backoffice: Optional. Set a role name (e.g. backoffice) to send this step to everyone with that role instead of the candidate bundle.
fieldHints.Optioneel Bijvoorbeeld \"conversation\": Optional. E.g. "conversation": the notification then links to the matching "conversation_id" field from the trigger, so it becomes clickable.
fieldHints.candidate = kandidaat, customer = klant,: candidate = candidate, customer = customer, customer_location = customer location, vacancy = vacancy.
fieldHints.Selecteert alle klanten / klantlocaties: Selects every customer / customer location / vacancy (max. 10,000, archived excluded). Does not work for candidates: use the "Fetch candidates" step for those.
fieldHints.Opgeteld bij de dagen (bv 1 dag + 3 uur): Added to the days (e.g. 1 day + 3 hours).
fieldHints.Valt het moment in het weekend, dan word: If the moment falls on a weekend, it moves to Monday at the same time.
fieldHints.De volledige, tenant-bewerkbare instruct: The full, tenant-editable instruction for the AI agent: persona, step state machine, hard rules. The runtime response contract is added automatically.
fieldHints.Reageert de kandidaat niet, dan valt de: If the candidate doesn't reply, the run falls back after this many hours (workflows:resume-due watchdog).
fieldHints.Alleen gekoppelde WhatsApp Web-nummers (: Only connected WhatsApp Web numbers (personal or branch).
fieldHints.Via WhatsApp Web kan alleen een sessiebe: Via WhatsApp Web only a session message (free text) can be sent.
